SOUND II wave grid (1F:0A, 05:6A82): the grid is edited only while A STAYS held (05:6A92-6A96 leaves it when A is released); with A kept held, Right moves the cell cursor $D8D0 (05:6ACC) and Up changes the cell value (05:6AE1). Joypad only, from the route of dj_pages.py: Select, Select, Up, Up, then A held for the rest of the sequence
